meaning: This directory now holds TWO tournaments and they must never be conflated. The pre_inactives_* boards were sealed at 2026-09-10T21:18:56Z, before any official inactive information existed, and they stand unchanged. The post_inactives_* boards were sealed at 2026-09-11T00:16:27Z, 18 minutes before kickoff, governed by the official inactive lists for both clubs.

parser_readiness.machine_parse: has never seen a populated inactives page; every one of the 83 captures in nfl/vintage/ is the empty state, so it refuses conservatively rather than segment a format it has not observed
parser_readiness.assisted_path: verify_supplied_names / --names-json; every supplied name must occur verbatim in the stored official bytes, so the operator supplies the segmentation and never the information

official_inactives.not_a_capture_of_nfl_com: This executor never reached the announcement (HTTP 000, gateway CONNECT denial). The chain of custody runs official page -> networked agent -> delivered artifact -> here. The generic /inactives/ page this executor COULD reach carried its placeholder through the entire window and is the wrong document to verify against.

known_defect_at_seal: The QB layer does not consume official_inactive_ids. Kurtis Rourke retains 0.90 dropbacks and Ty Simpson 0.73 on the post-inactives boards while both are officially inactive, so roughly 2.5% of team dropbacks stay allocated to quarterbacks who are not dressed rather than redistributing to Purdy and Stafford. The receiving layer consumes the same list correctly. Found 9 minutes before kickoff and recorded rather than patched; it belongs to the QB accounting track.
